mapper.select: SELECT updatedAt, type, rentPrice, realtorId, price, id, createdAt, area, address FROM `real_estate` where id=#{id}

SELECT updatedAt, type, rentPrice, realtorId, price, id, createdAt, area, address FROM `real_estate` where
rentPrice< #{rent_price}

SELECT updatedAt, type, rentPrice, realtorId, price, id, createdAt, area, address FROM `real_estate` where
area >= #{area} and price <= #{price}
